3734222.reason: Uses twice the sum of side lengths as the floor area. Test 0002 has sides 2,2,2 and seven tiles (one center and six surrounding), but outputs 12.

3734256.reason: Computes only from a and c, discarding b, and counts c//a iterations rather than the hexagonal area. At test 0003, 7,8,13 gives 40 instead of 224.

4389974.reason: Uses the perimeter expression 2*(a+b+c) instead of the number of floor tiles; at test 0002, 2,2,2 outputs 12 rather than 7.

4390462.reason: Adds an unjustified parity-based central tile after summing layers. Test 0003 has 7+8+13 even, so it adds one and outputs 225, although independent lattice-point counting gives 224.

4390480.reason: After peeling the shortest side it adds a center only when all sides are equal, omitting the remaining nonsymmetric interior. Test 0004, sides 14,7,75, yields 1176 instead of 1578.
